name: Tiangong
description: China’s modular space station — Tianhe core plus Wentian and Mengtian science labs, fully assembled in October 2022 and continuously crewed since June 2022. With a mass of ~66 t and pressurised volume of ~110 m³, Tiangong is smaller than Mir (130 t) but represents China’s permanent station capability; the only currently-operational space station outside ISS.
